sourceReview.reason: Rechecked AMBCrypto's complete Nov 12 report, which attributes $607m tokenized-equity supply on Solana, 75% xStocks share, 2,102 products and 1.89m holders to Blockworks. A dated full original Blockworks dataset establishing these exact measures was not located. The Nov 12 Wall Street Journal report independently confirms the separate launch of 200+ UK and European tokenized stocks, but does not corroborate the $607m or 75% metrics; it cannot validate this headline. No source-enrichment verification. Retry no sooner than six hours after this UTC review if original dated metrics or two independent full reports become available.
